title: Insurance Performance Summary
subtitle: Key metrics and solvency status

overview.text: The insurer reported gross written premiums of CHF 340 million [F1]. The combined ratio, a measure of underwriting efficiency, stood at 103.4% in 2025, up from 96.8% in 2024 [F2, F3]. This increase indicates that claims and expenses exceeded premiums in the current period.

Catastrophe claims contributed CHF 28 million of losses [F4]. Despite the higher combined ratio, the company maintained a solvency coverage of 184% [F5]. The company did not publish a forecast for next year's earnings [F6].

risks.text: The combined ratio exceeding 100% in 2025 suggests underwriting losses, driven partly by catastrophe claims of CHF 28 million [F2, F4].
